messages:
maria_sre: heads up — eu-west1 control plane is noisy. apiserver returning 503s, controller-manager leader flips every ~30s, and gpu-provisioner failing to attach nodes. seeing lots of etcd peer timeouts in the same window.

k8s-alerts-bot: [ALERT] apiserver 503 spike (rate=220/s) | etcd_peer_timeouts=45 in 5m | region=eu-west1

josh_infra: +1. I can see proxy NAT SNAT port exhaustion on the egress NAT gateway for eu-west1. conntrack and SNAT counters are bumping.

liam_runtime: any recent deploys or autoscaler activity? the leader flips suggest controlplane latency, maybe slow heartbeats to etcd.

maria_sre: no deploys at the time. autoscaler quiet. disk iops on the etcd nodes spiked ~3x matching the window, but the NVMe pool looked healthy otherwise.

anya_prod: customers in eu reporting inference errors (model attach fails). this is affecting Dedicated pools — GPUs stay Pending. is fallback routing to other regions enabled?

josh_infra: fallback currently only for best-effort routing; Dedicated is pinned. We could temporarily failover Dedicated pools -> shared-hosted in other regions but need approval — cost/latency hit.

liam_runtime: quick checks: 1) curl -k https://apiserver-eu-west1.internal/healthz returns 503 and stacktrace shows kube-apiserver heavy GC pauses in logs, 2) etcd logs show slow disk fsyncs and raft election timeouts, 3) controller-manager lease renewals delayed.

maria_sre: pasted a small log snippet:
```
I0321 12:03:11.123456 1 etcdserver/server.go:812] apply took too long (took = 124.6ms)
W0321 12:03:12.654321 1 watchers.go:214] watch-cache: Redispatch backlog 300ms
E0321 12:03:13.987654 1 apiserver.go:420] GET /api/v1/namespaces/default/pods: 503 
```

josh_infra: looks like egress NAT hit + transient I/O amplifying latency. I opened a ticket with cloud: NAT scaling request and asked for interim port increase. ticket# CLD-34921.

anya_prod: what's the mitigation plan? customers are hitting errors from Dedicated.

liam_runtime: short term: 1) pause non-essential controlplane background tasks (compact/defrag scheduling), 2) reduce apiserver read pressure by enabling read-only caching on heavy callers (enable local prefix KV cache where possible), 3) for Dedicated pools, consider temporary unpin + route to eu-central or us-east for critical customers.

maria_sre: implementing pause of etcd compaction schedule now (kubectl annotate nodes...). pushing a canary to move small subset of Dedicated attachments to eu-central.

k8s-alerts-bot: [INFO] mitigation action recorded: etcd_compaction_paused by maria_sre at 1717240020

josh_infra: cloud responded: temporary NAT port quota increase granted for 1h; provider suggests long-term fix is adding another NAT gateway and redistributing egress.

anya_prod: if we failover Dedicated -> shared-hosted for some customers, we need to log the cost delta. estimate for 50 concurrent model attachments = +$4.5k/day. we should get finance signoff.

liam_runtime: agree on cost note. Also add a postmortem checklist: investigate disk latency root cause (firmware or kernel scheduler?), revisit NAT design for high connection fanout, and add controlplane burst capacity runbook for GPU attach storms.

maria_sre: leaving this thread open — will update after the canary migration finishes. thanks all :thumbsup:

josh_infra: update: NAT ports holding for now, SNAT counters trending down after temporary rule. cloud still recommends adding dedicated egress nodes for Dedicated customers.

maria_sre: last update — canary moved 12/15 jobs to eu-central, attach success rate back to 98%. keeping etcd compaction paused for 10 more minutes, then re-evaluating.

anya_prod: filing customer comms template now.

liam_runtime: filing postmortem stub. assigning action items.

k8s-alerts-bot: [RESOLVE] apiserver spike subsided at 1717240050
